assets: iOS app com.example.wallet 4.2.0 (source only, no IPA)

findings.title: Backups enabled
findings.observation: android:allowBackup is true in the merged manifest of the release build, and no backup rules exclude the token store.
findings.impact: Anyone with ADB access to an unlocked device can extract app data, including cached session tokens.
findings.recommendation: Set android:allowBackup="false", or add dataExtractionRules / fullBackupContent that exclude sensitive files.

findings.title: Cleartext only in debug config
findings.observation: scan_source.py rule AND-NET-1 matched android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" in the debug source set only.
findings.impact: None for release builds: the debug manifest is not merged into release.
findings.recommendation: Keep the allowance in src/debug; confirm on the next release APK.
findings.response: The match is in the debug source set, which release builds do not include. The release manifest does not set usesCleartextTraffic. To be confirmed with inspect_apk.py on the next release APK (expect uses_cleartext null or false).
findings.evidence: git ls-files android/app/src: the only usesCleartextTraffic="true" is in src/debug/AndroidManifest.xml; src/main/AndroidManifest.xml has no override

findings.title: Certificate pins expired
findings.observation: The pin-set for api.example.invalid has expiration 2025-06-30 (days_left -507 on 2026-11-19). After that date Android stops enforcing the pins.
findings.impact: The app falls back to ordinary CA validation, so a mis-issued or user-installed CA can intercept API traffic.
findings.recommendation: Rotate the pin-set with current leaf/intermediate SPKI hashes plus a backup pin, and set a new expiration. Needs the backend team's certificate plan.
findings.response: Pin rotation needs the backend team's current and next certificate. Requested; status stays Open until a new build is verified.
findings.evidence: check_pins.py --nsc network_security_config.xml --today 2026-11-19: expiration 2025-06-30, days_left -507, backup_pin true

findings.title: Exported service without permission
findings.observation: com.example.wallet.sync.SyncService was exported with no permission in build 4.2.0.
findings.impact: Any installed app could start the sync service and trigger account sync.
findings.recommendation: Set android:exported="false", or protect the service with a signature-level permission.
findings.response: Set android:exported="false" on SyncService in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Verified on build 4.2.1 (421).
findings.evidence: inspect_apk.py app-release-4.2.1.apk: exported[] no longer lists com.example.wallet.sync.SyncService

findings.title: Root/jailbreak detection
findings.observation: Not assessed: needs a rooted/jailbroken test device and a hooking test. No detection library was found in the source scan.
findings.recommendation: Run the device test during the pentest; decide whether detection is in scope for this app's risk profile.
findings.evidence: no rooted/jailbroken test device: runtime check not run

findings.title: Binary protections (iOS)
findings.observation: PIE, ARC and stack canaries can only be checked on the built binaries. No IPA was provided.
findings.impact: Unknown until the IPA is inspected.
findings.recommendation: Provide a release IPA and run inspect_ipa.py.
